purpose: Approved browser sources for fact-checking and improving Interactive System Design lessons.

do_not_use_as_authority: a vendor page to prove a vendor-neutral claim
rules.citation_format: Use the registry id plus the direct page URL. Include the accessed date and the page update/publication date when available.
rules.copyright: Paraphrase. Do not reproduce proprietary books, paid courses, or long passages. Keep Primer attribution for content already present in this repository.

resources.title: The System Design Primer
not_for: current product behavior
strong technical authority when a standard or official document exists
resources.license_note: MIT attribution is required for the repository's imported material.

resources.title: ByteByteGo System Design Interview Course
not_for: sole authority for implementation-specific facts
copying proprietary lesson text or diagrams

resources.title: Designing Data-Intensive Applications, 2nd Edition
resources.publisher: Martin Kleppmann and Chris Riccomini / O'Reilly
not_for: current vendor API syntax unless corroborated by official vendor docs
resources.access_note: Use the public book page and accessible excerpts/metadata; do not bypass paywalls.

resources.title: Google Site Reliability Engineering Books
not_for: protocol specifications
vendor-specific service guarantees

resources.title: AWS Well-Architected Framework
not_for: vendor-neutral claims without an explicit AWS label

resources.title: Google Cloud Well-Architected Framework
not_for: general claims that ignore provider-specific assumptions

resources.title: PostgreSQL Documentation
not_for: universal behavior of all relational databases

resources.title: Apache Kafka Documentation
not_for: all message queues
claims that Kafka semantics automatically extend to external side effects

resources.title: Redis Documentation
not_for: treating Redis as a universal database recommendation

resources.title: OpenTelemetry Documentation
not_for: claiming that instrumentation alone makes a system observable

resources.title: HTTP Semantics, RFC 9110
resources.publisher: Internet Engineering Task Force / RFC Editor
not_for: framework-specific behavior

resources.title: The WebSocket Protocol, RFC 6455
resources.publisher: Internet Engineering Task Force / RFC Editor
not_for: presence, fan-out, or message durability architecture

resources.title: TLS 1.3, RFC 8446
resources.publisher: Internet Engineering Task Force / RFC Editor
not_for: complete application security guidance

resources.title: Domain Name System specifications
resources.publisher: Internet Engineering Task Force / RFC Editor
not_for: provider-specific routing policy claims

resources.title: Universally Unique Identifier, RFC 9562
resources.publisher: Internet Engineering Task Force / RFC Editor
not_for: choosing a globally unique ID architecture without workload context

resources.title: OWASP Application Security Verification Standard
not_for: cloud reliability or performance claims

resources.title: Dynamo: Amazon's Highly Available Key-value Store
not_for: assuming every modern DynamoDB behavior is identical to the original Dynamo paper

resources.title: In Search of an Understandable Consensus Algorithm
resources.publisher: Diego Ongaro and John Ousterhout / Stanford
not_for: claiming consensus is needed for every replicated data system

resources.title: gRPC Core Concepts
not_for: claiming gRPC is always better than HTTP/JSON

resources.title: Kubernetes Documentation
not_for: assuming Kubernetes removes distributed-systems trade-offs

resources.title: Amazon S3 User Guide
not_for: assuming all object stores have identical consistency and pricing

resources.title: Cloudflare Cache Documentation
not_for: universal CDN behavior
assuming a CDN is complete DDoS protection

resources.title: HTTP Live Streaming Resources
not_for: general video-transcoding cost estimates

resources.title: Robots Exclusion Protocol, RFC 9309
resources.publisher: Internet Engineering Task Force / RFC Editor
not_for: assuming robots.txt is an access-control mechanism

resources.title: Firebase Cloud Messaging Documentation
not_for: general guarantees about every push provider
